messages:
olivia: Quick heads up — scheduling an internal pentest against staging next Tue 09:00 PT. Need to lock down RBAC change window, KMS access pattern, and log export sampling. Who can own evidence packaging and assessor access?

devon: I can own RBAC gating. plan: create timeboxed assessor role + deny wide-admin, limited to staging namespaces and read-only logs. will draft policy today. :white_check_mark:

sara: For KMS we prefer not to hand out raw key access. two options: 1) create a KMS key with Encrypt/Decrypt + Grant usage via a proxy lambda, or 2) issue a short-lived KMS grant with an explicit grant token. leaning proxy for auditability.

mike: Agree proxy is safer. If we go proxy we need an ingress-only endpoint that logs requests and signs the operation. Also need to confirm HSM policy for key usage — some keys can't be granted.

devon: Draft RBAC snippet I'm proposing:
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Action":["sts:AssumeRole"],"Resource":"arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/assessor-temp"},
    {"Effect":"Deny","Action":["iam:CreateUser","iam:PutRolePolicy","kms:CreateKey"],"Resource":"*"}
  ]
}
```

olivia: Nice. sara — if we do proxy, what permissions does assessor role need to call it? Just invoke + CloudWatch publish?

sara: Yes: invoke -> ``lambda:InvokeFunction`` on the proxy, plus ``logs:CreateLogStream`` / ``logs:PutLogEvents``. Proxy will then call KMS using its own service role. Also will attach request-id tags so we can correlate evidence.

mike: For evidence packaging: generate presigned S3 objects for the assessor to upload screenshots/exploit traces. We'll provide a presigned folder valid for the window. Example command to generate: 
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-pt-staging/evidence/${ASSESSOR_ID}/ --region us-west-2 --expires-in 3600
```
Note: presign doesn't do folders, we'll create objects programmatically.

pen-test-bot: Ticket created: SEC-4521 "staging internal pentest intake" — assignee: devon, due: next Tue 08:00 PT.

devon: Logging/export ask: we need 72h continuous logs prior and full traces during window. Can infra guarantee ES ingest + S3 export within 30m for staging? If not, we need to snapshot earlier.

olivia: infra SLA says export within 4h normally. ops-team recommended we run ad-hoc snapshot job before test. mike — can you schedule snapshot at Mon 23:00 PT?

mike: yep scheduling snapshot job and will stash in s3://redwood-pt-evidence/staging/snapshots/2026-03-23/ :calendar: 

olivia: Final checklist (action owners): devon -> create/timebox role + policy, sara -> implement proxy + attest grants, mike -> snapshot + presigned evidence bucket, pen-test-bot -> keep ticket updated. We'll do a dry run Friday 10:00 PT. If anyone can't make that time shout here.
